verdicts_note: Every portrait was checked at original size against its reference assets. Retries are capped at 3 per id.

assets.notes: Dual-form silhouette: human silhouette behind, pig silhouette in front, lotus and lavender ribbon, moonlit rim light. Back view, so no face is shown. Replaces the earlier pig-only portrait (raw/yeoni.png, sha256 062a1bc3724279cb1d840b963857b840030ed3bf4ed9e9a884e8dd520c6a6676), which was removed from the page.
Yeongnyangi form. Two ears checked at original size; hat tilted to the right. No lion reference. Not a self-display pose.
Otter anatomy kept (ears, whiskers, webbed paws, tail). Headphones.
Human fortune-teller. Name in the page: 윤달.
Hooded crow judge. Not labelled with the hidden identity name.
assets.deviation: The plan listed mu-01.webp as a second reference. It was not attached, so the portrait cannot reveal the identity before EP.32.
The reflection is very close to the Yeoni portrait. The only differences are a raised paw and a glassy sheen. The difference is weak and should be reviewed.

assets.notes: Human form, high closed lace collar. Face, hair, red gems and expression kept.

dropped.altPortrait: The plan's altPortrait field was dropped. The page shows one portrait per character to keep it simpler.

places.note: No new place art. The page reuses existing backgrounds under public/images/novel/ (remaster/*-v1.webp).

forbidden_check: The world-data static test checks the forbidden names and spoiler terms from the canon constants (FORBIDDEN_STORY_NAMES) in the rendered data and in page.js. Comments are excluded.
